subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Does the agents/path-boundary owner accept using case-preserving normalized inputs because `path.win32.relative` performs its own case-insensitive comparison while returning the original-cased destination tail?
rationale: Source, dependency code, Node’s implementation, regression tests, and live Windows proof support equivalence, but repository policy reserves ownership of sandbox-boundary changes for a human reviewer.

options.title: Approve the boundary invariant
options.body: Accept the current implementation after exact-head required checks complete because comparison structure is unchanged and returned casing is corrected.

options.title: Separate check and return paths
options.body: Require distinct comparison and case-preserving relative values if the owner does not want containment to rely directly on Node’s implementation contract.
